title: Decoded book edges under vertex coordinates
statement: Let $q,k$ be natural numbers and let $c$ be a perfect-matching code of order $\lfloor qk/2\rfloor$. Mapping both endpoints of every decoded book edge to their corresponding elements of $\mathrm{Fin}(qk)$ gives exactly the list obtained by decoding $c$ from the standard list of elements of $\mathrm{Fin}(qk)$.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect-matching code of order $\lfloor qk/2\rfloor$
